title: Sweep the remaining scrollable panes: decisions detail, questions detail, waves item pane, settings

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S531 added `TestScrollSweep` (`internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go:212`). It pages each scrollable view to its end and back at heights 10, 16, 24 and 40, and fails when a line never appears. Its table covers the help overlay, the Roadmap row list and item pane, and the launch confirm. Four other panes scroll with their own state and are not in the table. The comment above the test does not name them as left out.

- Decisions detail: `decisionScroll`, `internal/tui/decisions.go:95` and `:109`.
- Questions detail: `internal/tui/questions.go:88`, sharing `decisionScroll`.
- Waves item pane: `paneOffset`, `internal/tui/waves.go:918-926` and `:987`.
- Settings pane: `settingsState.offset` and the `+N lines above` marker, `internal/tui/settings.go:373-400`.

The owner decided (adj 584, "Extend, then record") that each pane joins the table through a test-only fixture. Any pane that still cannot be reached is named in the Left out comment with the reason. The existing harnesses reach all four panes, and each needs only more content:

- `decisionsHarness` (`decisions_test.go:16`), then Enter.
- `questionsHarness` (`questions_test.go:16`), then Down and Enter.
- `wavesHarness` plus `openWaves` (`waves_test.go:123` and `:137`), then Enter with `wavesLive.details` set.
- `settingsHarness` (`settings_test.go:58`).

A pane whose sweep finds a real paging defect follows adj 575 and the S531 precedent (the first-sweep Left out comment, S579, S580): file a follow-up slice, and leave that pane or height out with a named Left out entry until it lands.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - `internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go:205-359` (TestScrollSweep, TestSweepPaneFixturesScroll and the four pane fixtures).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestScrollSweep` (`internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go:226`, new subtests `decisions-detail/hN`, `questions-detail/hN`, `waves-item/hN` and `settings/hN`, N = 10, 16, 24, 40): page down and up with pgdown and pgup; every distinct content line of the height-200 render appears in each pass. A skipped line follows Implement step 5; S601-S604 track the failing heights.
- `TestSweepPaneFixturesScroll` (`internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go:279`): at 80x10 each setup draws a `+N more lines` marker and a different frame after pgdown. Short Questions and Waves fixtures fail both checks before their content is extended. Decisions and Settings already scroll at height 10; mutation checks verify their assertions.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go`, add four setup functions of type `func(*testing.T) *harness`, next to `sweepHelp`. Each builds its own long, line-unique content:
   - `sweepDecisionsDetail`: `decisionsHarness(t)`. Set `h.m.projects[0].snap.Open.Value[0].History` to about 40 `adjcli.Event` values with distinct text, such as `fmt.Sprintf("2026-10-%02d event number %02d", ...)`. Then `h.deliver(press("enter"))` and fail the test if `h.m.decisionPane == nil`.
   - `sweepQuestionsDetail`: `questionsHarness(t)`. Give `h.m.projects[0].snap.Open.Value[0]` the same long `History`. Then `h.deliver(press("down"))`, because the first row is the engine question, then `h.deliver(press("enter"))`. Fail if `h.m.decisionPane == nil` or `h.m.pane != nil`.
   - `sweepWavesItem`: `wavesHarness(t)`. Set `l.details = map[string]*slicercli.Detail{"A": ...}` to a `Slice` with about 60 `Section`s with distinct headings and bodies, as `longItemDetail` does at `roadmap_test.go:724`. Then `openWaves(t, h)` and `h.deliver(press("enter"))`. Fail if `h.m.waves.pane == nil`.
   - `sweepSettings`: `settingsHarness(t)`. If the `settingsFixture` body fits at height 24, add test-only lines, such as more `VendorEnv` keys with distinct names. The pane shows key names and never values.
2. Add four rows to the `cases` slice in `TestScrollSweep`, each with `heights: sweepAll`, `pageDown: sweepPgDown` and `pageUp: sweepPgUp`: `decisions-detail`, `questions-detail`, `waves-item` and `settings`.
   - Leave `reference` nil, so each takes its own height-200 render.
   - Set `unique: true` on each case whose reference holds no repeated line.
   - Leave `unique` unset, with a comment as on `roadmap-item`, on a case whose pane repeats a line, such as its own heading.
3. Add `TestSweepPaneFixturesScroll` in the same file. For each of the four setups, set the window to 80x10 and check the first frame holds a `more lines` marker. Then deliver pgdown and check the frame differs from the first. Use `sweepLines` and `sweepMarker`.
4. Run `go -C /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork test -run TestScrollSweep ./internal/tui`. Do not change the sweep helpers or any non-test file.
5. For each pane or height that reports a skipped line, file a follow-up slice with slicer. Leave that pane or height out of the table and name it in a "Left out" paragraph in the `TestScrollSweep` doc comment, as in `d8fbeaba`. Each entry gives the pane, the key and heights, the cause as `file:function`, and the follow-up ID, per adj 575. Put every other pane in the table. If no pane fails, change nothing in the comment except naming the four new panes as covered.
6. If a pane cannot be reached with enough content, add it to the Left out comment with the reason, per adj 584. The tracing found no such pane.
7. Run `go vet ./...` and `gofmt -l .`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -run TestScrollSweep ./internal/tui` exits 0 with the four new panes in the table. The -v output lists TestScrollSweep/decisions-detail/h10 to h40 and the same for questions-detail, waves-item and settings. Any pane left out is named in the Left out comment, with a follow-up slice, and does not appear in the table.
- `go test -run TestSweepPaneFixturesScroll ./internal/tui` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestSweepMissingNamesSkippedLines ./internal/tui` exits 0, so the existing check that the sweep can fail still holds.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go vet ./...` prints nothing and exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- [HUMAN CHECK] Open the doc comment of TestScrollSweep in internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go. Each of decisions detail, questions detail, waves item pane and settings should be either a table row or a named Left out entry with a reason and a follow-up slice ID. No pane should be missing from both.
